content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-s09-anfsnj8_/report.rdl

Centre-align the numbers in the Operating Hours, Idle Hours and Utilization columns of the table.

I centre-aligned the detail cells in the Operating Hours, Idle Hours and Utilization columns of FleetTable. The change is saved in the report file.

I left the column headers alone, so they stay left-aligned above the centred numbers. If you want the headers centred too, I can do that as well.

The validation check flagged some existing issues that I didn't touch: two unused data sources (LegacySQL and ScratchPowerQuery), two date-like parameters (DateFrom and DateTo) typed as String, and a Utilization field in DataSet1 that the DAX query doesn't appear to return.
